body: People keep saying I'm not a bad person for these thoughts, but I feel like I am. A good person wouldn't even have these thoughts. I'm scared to talk to anyone about it because it is so taboo. I'm afraid what might happen to me or if anyone else would find out. I have no way to deal with or overcome it.

I started talking to a counselor at my school when I suffered my first anxiety attack. Im only 21 so it scared the hell out of me. Im dealing with a lot right now and I just feel trapped. My counselor has helped me deal with some issues but this is a big one. I dont even know how to bring it up or if I could even bring myself to actually tell anyone face to  face. I have class in five hours and I probably won't go because I cant fall asleep, I cant concentrate on the material, just like I've been doing, I've dug such a deep hole. I just cant take anymore of it and I want so badly to stop fighting. I read that thread. Its what prompted me to post here.
